profile.headline: Software Engineer at New Relic, Inc.
profile.summary: Software developer specializing in Ruby on Rails and JavaScript based programming with a background in government relations. As a full stack dev, I enjoy building out features with the user in mind and bringing an application's visual design to life while also getting in deep with database queries and design on the backend.

positions.title: Government Affairs Specialist
positions.description:
My focus in the Government Affairs Department was community relations, in which I served as a key liaison between the Museum and area residents/local merchants on issues affecting the neighborhood. I also assisted the Chief Government Affairs Officer and Government Affairs Manager on advocacy for funding and arts policy with New York City government officials.

• Managed database and communications to area residents and other community members on construction projects and issues relating to The Met Fifth Avenue and The Met Breuer locations
• Attended New York City Council hearings and local community board meetings, building relationships with Council staff and civic leaders
• Participated in advocacy events and attended meetings of the Cultural Institutions Group, a coalition of cultural institutions in New York City on city-owned properties
• Served as an alternate member on the board of the Madison Avenue Business Improvement District, working closely with the BID president on merchant issues and community events
• Managed the department’s role with the semi-annual Teens Take The Met event

positions.title: Senior Congressional Aide
positions.description:
Served as Senior Congressional Aide to Congresswoman Barbara Lee, representing the 13th Congressional District in California

• Advised the Congresswoman on legislative priorities, casework trends, and issues in the community
• Staffed and prepared the Congresswoman for community events (wrote talking points, speeches, and Congressional Records; background and legislative research; prepared briefing materials)
• Effective community outreach and relationship building with community stakeholders, elected officials, and federal agency officials
• Organized and executed outreach events, ranging from small to large-scale, often with a short turnaround due to pressing legislative or community needs
• Casework speciality in mortgage and foreclosure issues
• Managed the internship program through recruiting, hiring and training interns for 3 internship sessions each school year
